title: Switch Allocation Method While Positions Are Open
precondition: MAM group has 3 active open trades.
steps: 1. Manager attempts to change allocation method from PBB to Lot Multiplier.
expected_result: Action blocked with error: 'Cannot change allocation method while open positions exist. Please close all group positions first'.
actual_result: In-flight open positions preserve original allocation weighting; updates apply deterministically to subsequent parent block orders.

evidence.design_pattern: Immutable trade snapshot per open order
